meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: Staff Development decisions are made by the Site Staff Development Committee. [MN Statute §122A.60] As MN Statute §122A.68 Subd.2 states that the resident year should be considered as a first year placement, resident teachers will be recommended for continued employment as a second-year teacher on the salary schedule with seniority number based on the initial contract signed during the residency year.
